READ                                                  TravellerRead the text and answer the questions.


  The Durham Sports Centre is open and ready for business! You can walk around or go
  jogging on our new athletics track. There is also a new gym. It’s very modern and great for
  gymnastics and other sports. We’ve also got a great Olympic swimming pool and a new
  hockey rink. Tennis isn’t much fun when it’s hot outside, so we’ve got ten tennis courts
  and they are all indoors! We’ve also got two indoor volleyball courts and one outside,
  too. The Durham Sports Centre is also a great place to hang out with your friends and play
  video games or pool. You don’t need to be an athlete to have fun here, because there is
  something for everybody. Come and visit us today!


1. What can you do on the athletics track?
2. What is very modern?
3. How many tennis courts are there?
4. Where are the volleyball courts?
5. What can people that don’t like sports do there ?
                                                               SCORE     10
WRITE
Write an e-mail to a friend giving him/her your news. Write about one of the following ideas.

-your new house: Where is it? What’s it like? Do you like it?
-your new neighbourhood: What’s it like? What kind of buildings/places has it got? Do you like it?
-a new friend: What does he/she look like? Where did you meet him/her? What do you do together in your free
 time?
-a party/concert/holiday: When did you go? Who did you go with? Were there lots of people there? What did you
 do? Did you have fun?
-an accident: When did it happen? What happened? Did you hurt/break anything?
-your holiday/weekend plans: Where are you going to go? Who are you going to go with? What are you going to

 do there?
